claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the console; no controller/accessories are visible, and 'special edition' is not readable.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/special edition cannot be confirmed from the photo; pricing depends on model and edition.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label showing the full model code (CUH-xxxx) readable (serial can be blurred).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PS4 slim console with unknown edition.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing or different from what’s claimed (controller(s), cables, pads, receipt).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included items laid out together (console + controller(s) + cables + any pads/discs + receipt).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no guaranteed accessories/receipt).

risks.risk: Ports/controllers may fail under real use even if seller says they tested.
risks.proof: Short video: boot to home screen + HDMI connected + test at least two USB ports + controller connected and responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case: ports/controllers may need repair.

risks.risk: Overheating/fan issues may not show in a quick check and can worsen over time.
risks.proof: Video of 15–20 minutes running with fan noise audible (and ideally a temperature readout if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (treated as needing service).

risks.risk: Console may have been opened/serviced or has replaced parts despite the claim.
risks.proof: Photos of warranty/void stickers (if any) and a close-up of the underside/serial area; optionally internal photo if seller allows.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the console label with the full PS4 model code (CUH-xxxx) readable.
Send a photo of everything included laid out (controller(s), cables, pads/discs, receipt).
Send a short video showing: HDMI boot to home screen + at least two USB ports tested + controller working.
Send a 15–20 minute running video (fan/heat check).
response.reason: The seller’s text claim that they tested it does not replace missing visual proof. Without new photos/videos, I can’t verify the special edition, included accessories/receipt, or that ports and cooling are truly working—so I can’t price confidently at worst-case.
